materials.not: Hazardous, medical or contaminated waste, and damaged or leaking equipment.

materials.name: Beer bottles
materials.guide: Empty beer bottles, kept separate and safely packed. The displayed rate is per kilogram, not per bottle.
materials.not: Hazardous, medical or contaminated waste, and damaged or leaking equipment.

materials.name: Other paper
materials.guide: Separated paper other than newspaper, books or kraft. Describe the grade and keep it clean and dry.
materials.not: Hazardous, medical or contaminated waste, and damaged or leaking equipment.

materials.name: Books
materials.guide: Old books, notebooks and loose office sheets. Remove plastic covers and separate bindings where practical.
materials.not: Wet paper and confidential documents requiring certified destruction.

materials.name: Kraft / cardboard
materials.guide: Clean corrugated boxes and kraft packaging. Flatten boxes and remove loose packing material.
materials.not: Food-soiled, wax-coated or wet cardboard.

materials.name: Old newspaper
materials.guide: Dry old newspapers, separated from other paper. Keep the bundle clean and dry.
materials.not: Wet, laminated or food-soiled paper.

materials.name: Reusable clothes
materials.guide: Clean, dry reusable clothing such as jeans, shirts, T-shirts, sarees and kurtas. Condition is checked before acceptance.
materials.not: Undergarments, bedding, blankets, pillows and mattresses.

materials.name: Iron (MS scrap)
materials.guide: Iron household scrap and clean iron offcuts. Share size and access details for heavy pieces.
materials.not: Pressurised containers and sharp pieces without safe packaging.

materials.name: Tin
materials.guide: Clean tin scrap and empty metal containers, kept separate from other metals.
materials.not: Containers with chemical, paint or hazardous residue.

materials.name: Brass
materials.guide: Brass fittings, taps and separated brass pieces. Grade and attached parts affect the final valuation.
materials.not: Unidentified alloys or contaminated fittings.

materials.name: Water taps (steel)
materials.guide: Share the type, quantity, condition and pickup access. Keep materials separated for inspection.
materials.not: Hazardous, medical or contaminated waste, and damaged or leaking equipment.

materials.name: Iron cupboard
materials.guide: Share the type, quantity, condition and pickup access. Keep materials separated for inspection.
materials.not: Hazardous, medical or contaminated waste, and damaged or leaking equipment.

materials.name: Steel (SS scrap)
materials.guide: Steel household articles, fixtures and clean offcuts. Describe bulky pieces in your request.
materials.not: Sealed or pressurised equipment.

materials.name: Aluminium
materials.guide: Aluminium utensils, sections and fittings. Separate other metals and attached material where possible.
materials.not: Pressurised containers or contaminated pieces.

materials.name: Copper
materials.guide: Separated copper material, wires and fittings. Tell us whether the wire is insulated.
materials.not: Live electrical equipment and unidentified or contaminated material.

materials.name: Mixed plastic
materials.guide: Empty bottles and rigid plastic articles. Keep different plastic grades separate for inspection.
materials.not: Chemical containers, medical waste and dirty mixed packaging.

materials.name: Tyre
materials.guide: Describe the type, quantity and condition. Keep tyres separate from metal rims for valuation.
materials.not: Hazardous, medical or contaminated waste, and damaged or leaking equipment.
